results.description: the immutability check on the ledger is removed
results.detail: LedgerViolation: the ledger accepted a changed horizon on an existing expectation; the forward record is editable

results.description: the horizon check is removed from the state machine
results.detail: AssertionError: an expectation expiring 2027-01-01 resolved on 2026-03-01 as RESOLVED; the horizon no longer gates resolution
AssertionError: fifty UNRESOLVED predictions moved the ladder to EARLY_CALIBRATION; an accuracy figure would be reported from predictions that have not happened yet
AssertionError: twenty predictions from ONE origin reported 20 origins; the forward record would repeat the row-bootstrap mistake the historical programme spent two runs correcting

results.description: the first-release branch is removed from the resolver
results.detail: AssertionError: a FIRST_RELEASE contract resolved with 200.0, the later revision. The prediction was about what the world would print, and a better estimate of the truth is the wrong answer to it

results.description: a human-state series is marked for promotion to a driver
results.detail: AssertionError: ['UMCSENT'] appear in the company driver table while CollectiveHumanState is FROZEN_CANDIDATE with zero promoted constructs; an unsupported construct would reach a Founder recommendation

results.description: the lineage walk stops finding ancestors
results.detail: AssertionError: a corroborator two hops up the lineage was not found; a derived aggregate can corroborate its own input as long as one intermediate hides it

results.description: the visibility check is removed from the state builder
results.detail: AssertionError: EconomicState.build no longer checks node visibility; a tenant-private observation could enter the shared public state

results.description: an unmeasured dimension stops reporting BLOCKED
results.detail: AssertionError: a dimension with no producer and no source reports PARTIAL; an unmeasured dimension would leave the denominator and coverage would inflate

results.description: the candidate-status check on a bleed is removed
results.detail: WorldModelDefect: a causal bleed carries status 'PROVEN_CAUSE'. A bleed is a measured non-response with a CANDIDATE explanation. Rates fell, demand did not respond, therefore fear -- is a story, and the whole point of the object is that it stays one until something tests it.

results.description: the scenario type is collapsed into the causal one
results.detail: AssertionError: the counterfactual type wall no longer separates a scenario assumption from a causal estimate; a History Rewind what-if would render with the standing of a measured effect

results.description: the no-change branch of the stagnation detector is removed
results.detail: AssertionError: the stagnation detector no longer alerts when no company analysis changes; evidence arriving with nothing moving would be recorded as a healthy cycle

results.description: the channel requirement on an implication is removed
results.detail: AssertionError: an implication with no channel and no driver was accepted; a founder recommendation could change with nothing to attribute it to

results.description: the append becomes a whole-file write
results.detail: AssertionError: after a resolution the ledger holds 1 record(s) and the original OPEN record is gone; the prediction was overwritten by its own outcome
